name: 中華民國醫事檢驗師公會全國聯合會
summary: 全國醫檢師公會、地方公會及執業資訊。
summary_en: National and local professional associations, membership and practice resources.
note: 取得醫檢師證書後，執業登記、執照與加入所在地公會依臺灣法規辦理。
note_en: Professional registration, practising permits and local association membership follow Taiwan regulations.

name: 台灣醫事檢驗學會
summary: 學術研討會、研究發表、專門領域醫檢師及專業能力進階資訊。
summary_en: Scientific meetings, publications, specialist and professional development programmes.
note: 學會會員或專業能力進階資格，與政府核發的醫檢師執照屬不同制度。
note_en: Society membership and advanced credentials are distinct from statutory licensure.

name: 考選部國家考試
summary: 查詢國考公告、報名入口及歷屆試題；以考選部當年度簡章與更正公告為準。
summary_en: Exam notices, online registration and past papers; check the current official notices.
note: 報名資格、日期與考科可能依年度修正。
note_en: Confirm eligibility, application windows and subjects for each examination cycle.

name: 衛福部醫事人員繼續教育積分
summary: 查詢醫事人員繼續教育積分與執業更新相關資訊。
summary_en: Continuing education credit inquiries and practising permit renewal resources.
note: 相關積分及更新規則請再核對主管機關最新公告。
note_en: Always check current credit and practising-permit renewal rules.

name: 醫事檢驗師法
summary: 了解醫檢師證書、執業登記、業務範圍與公會規定。
summary_en: Statutory scope of practice, registration, certificates and association requirements.
note: 以全國法規資料庫現行條文為準。
note_en: Refer to the current text in the official laws database.

name: ASCP 國際醫檢師認證
summary: 依學位、臨床訓練或工作經歷的不同途徑申請國際 MLS 認證。
summary_en: International MLS certification with route-specific education, training and experience requirements.
note: ASCPi 是專業認證；美國各州執業許可、雇用及簽證仍須另行確認。
note_en: Certification does not replace U.S. state licensure, employment or immigration requirements.

name: AMT 醫檢師認證
summary: 美國 AMT 的 Medical Laboratory Scientist 認證與外國學歷評估途徑。
summary_en: AMT Medical Laboratory Scientist certification, including overseas transcript evaluation routes.
note: 取得 AMT 認證仍須另行核對州別許可及工作資格。
note_en: State licensure and work authorization must be checked separately.

name: 澳洲 AIMS 技能與學歷評估
name_en: Australian Institute of Medical and Clinical Scientists
summary: 海外學歷與技能評估，可供澳洲 MLS／MLT 移民職業評估使用。
summary_en: Overseas skills and qualifications assessment for MLS/MLT migration occupations.
note: AIMS 技能評估與雇用、簽證審核分屬不同程序。
note_en: Skills assessment, hiring and visa decisions are separate.

name: 英國 HCPC 生醫科學家註冊
summary: 海外受訓者需依國際申請途徑提出學歷、課程、能力與英語證明。
summary_en: International registration route reviews qualifications, training, competencies and English evidence.
note: 申請職類為 Biomedical Scientist；申請人須符合 HCPC 的專業能力標準。
note_en: The relevant protected professional title is Biomedical Scientist.

name: 紐西蘭醫檢專業註冊
name_en: Medical Sciences Council of New Zealand
summary: 國際學歷醫檢人員申請 Medical Laboratory Scientist 註冊之官方流程。
summary_en: Registration pathway for internationally qualified Medical Laboratory Scientists.
note: 註冊、年度執業證明與工作簽證需依個案確認。
note_en: Registration, annual practising certificate and immigration are separate steps.

name: 國際生醫實驗室科學聯盟
name_en: International Federation of Biomedical Laboratory Science (IFBLS)
summary: 國際醫檢專業交流、研討會與學術網絡。
summary_en: International biomedical laboratory science exchange and professional network.
note: IFBLS 為專業組織，並非各國的職業執照核發機關。
note_en: A professional federation, not a national licensing authority.

name: 日本｜臨床檢查技師
summary: 海外養成學校畢業或持海外相應執照者，須先向厚生勞動省申請國考應考資格認定；審查教育課程及實習。
summary_en: Foreign-trained applicants require MHLW recognition of exam eligibility before taking Japan's national examination.
note: 未於日本完成國中及高中者，認定標準包括日語能力試驗 N1；另有採血、生理檢查等課程要求。
note_en: JLPT N1 applies under the stated schooling condition; curriculum requirements include specimen collection and physiological testing.

name: 韓國｜臨床病理師
summary: 海外學校畢業者須依國試院程序辦理外國學校認定，再查核適用的國家考試資格。
summary_en: Overseas graduates must follow the foreign-school recognition process and the applicable Korean national examination rules.
note: 韓國國考不以國籍作一般限制；學校認定、職類資格與考試程序仍各自審查。
note_en: Nationality alone is not an exam restriction; academic recognition and profession-specific eligibility still apply.

name: 香港｜醫務化驗師
summary: 醫務化驗師管理委員會依《輔助醫療業條例》（現稱《專職醫療業條例》）審核學歷、課程與相關工作經歷。
summary_en: MLT Board assesses qualifications, laboratory science coursework and relevant professional experience.
note: 非預先列明的資格可按個案依第 12(1)(b) 條審核；第 I 部分註冊另有經驗條件。
note_en: Non-listed qualifications may receive individual assessment; Part I registration has additional experience rules.

name: 馬來西亞｜醫學檢驗技術人員
summary: 《2016 年專職醫療人員法》（Act 774）將 Medical Laboratory Technologist 列為受規範的專職醫療職類。
summary_en: Medical Laboratory Technologist is a regulated allied health profession under Act 774.
note: 外籍人士申請執業需依 Act 774 第 24 條向主管機關取得臨時執業證明，且須符合適用條件。
note_en: Foreign practitioners require a Council-issued temporary practising certificate subject to statutory conditions.

name: 新加坡｜醫學檢驗專業
summary: 新加坡 MOH 公開的 AHPC 法定註冊職類名單目前未將一般醫檢師列入；臨床實驗室服務本身受 HCSA 管理。
summary_en: General lab technologists are not among the listed AHPC-registered occupations; clinical laboratory services are regulated under HCSA.
note: 仍應逐一確認雇主要求的學歷、實驗室工作資格與工作准證；勿誤用醫師註冊規則。
note_en: Check employer qualifications and work-pass rules separately; medical doctor registration is a different profession.

name: 菲律賓｜醫學技術師
summary: 醫學技術師受 Republic Act No. 5527 規範，透過 PRC 職業資格考試及註冊途徑執業。
summary_en: Medical Technologists are regulated under RA 5527 and the PRC licensure framework.
note: 外國國籍申請者須符合雙邊互惠原則並提交證明，是否能應考由 PRC 審核。
note_en: Foreign applicants are subject to documented reciprocity requirements and PRC approval.
